title: White House AI timeline manipulator

tellings.quote: Talk about almost like a White House timeline manipulator, too.

plain: The idea, floated briefly, is of something like a 'White House timeline manipulator', a system in the American government that could steer which future happens. Michels mentions it himself in a 2026 conversation with the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell, tying it to a man named Matthew Brown, without saying more about what the device is or who runs it. If true, it would mean the government was trying to shape events by reaching across time.
